main:1.text: Prologue is the first mission in Grand Theft Auto V, involving Michael Townley and Trevor Philips. It is set in 2004 in the town of Ludendorff, North Yankton. In 2004, Michael Townley, Trevor Philips and Brad Snider rob a Bobcat Security cash storage facility in Ludendorff.

main:2.text: Franklin and Lamar is the first mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by car dealer Simeon Yetarian. Fellow protagonist Michael De Santa also makes an appearance in the opening cutscene of the mission. Nine years after the events of the Prologue, Michael Townley (now in his new alias Michael De Santa) is having a conversation with his therapist, Dr. Isiah Friedlander.

main:3.text: Repossession is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Armenian car salesman Simeon Yetarian from his business in Pillbox Hill. Franklin arrives at Simeon's car dealership, where Simeon names him 'Employee of the Month'.

main:4.text: Complications is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by car dealer Simeon Yetarian. Fellow protagonist Michael De Santa is also playable during the mission's final sequence. Simeon is seen arranging a deal with Mr. Kenneth in the front parking lot right outside his dealership from 8:00 to 18:00.

main:5.text: Father/Son is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V that protagonist Michael De Santa performs with the assistance of fellow protagonist Franklin Clinton. This mission can be started as either Michael or Franklin. If the player chooses to start the mission as Michael, a cutscene at Michael's mansion shows Amanda and Tracey arguing over whether Tracey can have a male friend stay the night.

main:6.text: Marriage Counseling is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V which protagonist Michael De Santa performs with the assistance of fellow protagonist Franklin Clinton. At home, Michael calls for his wife Amanda, to no answer. Stepping out of the house to smoke, Michael becomes suspicious when he notices two tennis rackets by the door.

main:7.text: Daddy's Little Girl is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Michael De Santa by his son Jimmy. At his mansion in Rockford Hills, Michael is eating from a bowl of potato chips while trying to watch a movie when his son Jimmy begins making too much noise upstairs. After turning his TV volume up to try and drown Jimmy out, Michael soon runs up to Jimmy's room and tells him to keep it down.

main:8.text: Chop is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Lamar Davis. Lamar's dog Chop makes his first appearance in this mission. In the mission, Chop helps Franklin track down and kidnap a Ballas member called D. Franklin returns to his house and overhears his aunt and her friend going out for a jog.

main:10.text: Friend Request is the first mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Michael De Santa by Lester Crest. With Michael now owing $2,500,000 to Martin Madrazo for his mistress' house that he pulled down with Franklin, he visits the home of an old friend named Lester Crest. After being let in, the two briefly catch up before Lester receives an alert about Lifeinvader founder Jay Norris.

main:11.text: Casing the Jewel Store is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given to protagonist Michael De Santa by Lester Crest. Michael meets Lester at his garment factory before the duo drive to the Vangelico Jewelry Store. Once on location, Lester instructs him to walk in and use a pair of camera-glasses to take pictures of the displays, ventilation and alarm system.

main:12.text: The Jewel Store Job is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V. It is the first heist mission in the game that protagonists Michael De Santa and Franklin Clinton undertake. In order to perform the heist, Michael must perform a couple of side-missions (Heist Setups) to gain the necessary equipment. The preparation missions vary based on the chosen approach in Casing the Jewel Store.

main:13.text: Mr. Philips is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V which Trevor Philips performs independently. Fellow protagonists Michael De Santa and Franklin Clinton also appear in the opening cutscene. After Franklin meets Michael at his house, they each have a drink to celebrate their successful heist.

main:14.text: Nervous Ron is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Trevor Philips by Ron Jakowski. The mission begins with Trevor arriving at his trailer, to find Ron, who anxiously informs him that The Lost MC have ransacked the trailer in retaliation for Johnny Klebitz's murder. What angers him the most is that they've managed to break apart his Impotent Rage statue.

main:15.text: Trevor Philips Industries is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Trevor Philips by Tao Cheng and his translator at the Yellow Jack Inn in Sandy Shores, San Andreas. Trevor meets Tao Cheng (who is high on drugs) and his translator at a bar.

main:16.text: Crystal Maze is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V that protagonist Trevor Philips does independently at the Yellow Jack Inn in Sandy Shores, San Andreas. Trevor arrives at the Yellow Jack Inn and confronts Tao and his interpreter. When they mention that they want to pursue other jobs, Trevor threatens them to get them to tell him who they are working with.

main:17.text: https://gta.fandom.com/wiki/File:FriendsReunited-GTAV-Quote.ogg Friends Reunited is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V which protagonist Trevor Philips performs independently at his safehouse in Sandy Shores, San Andreas. Trevor comes home to his trailer and sees Wade Hebert coming up to him and apologizing, only for Trevor to punch Wade off his front porch and ask if he found Michael Townley.

main:18.text: Fame or Shame is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V which protagonist Michael De Santa performs with the help of Trevor Philips at his mansion in Rockford Hills, Los Santos, San Andreas. The mission can be triggered by either Michael (triggered automatically by switching to him) or Trevor (by going to Michael's house).

main:19.text: Dead Man Walking is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given to protagonist Michael De Santa by FIB agent Dave Norton. Fellow protagonist  Franklin Clinton also makes an appearance in the final cutscene of the mission. Dave asks Michael to meet him at the Galileo Observatory.

main:21.text: By the Book is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given by FIB agent Steve Haines to protagonists Michael De Santa and Trevor Philips at the Walker & Sons Warehouse, on Dutch London Street in Banning, South Los Santos, San Andreas.

main:22.text: Scouting the Port is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V that Trevor Philips performs independently. The mission begins in Floyd's apartment in Vespucci Beach, where Trevor forces Floyd to help him with a new caper. After Trevor, Wade, and Floyd all dress in stolen longshoreman uniforms, Trevor drives Floyd and Wade to the Port of Los Santos.

main:23.text: The Merryweather Heist is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V. It is the second heist mission in the game that protagonists Michael De Santa and Franklin Clinton execute and the first to also involve Trevor Philips.

main:24.text: Did Somebody Say Yoga? is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V which protagonist Michael De Santa performs independently. Michael comes home to watch movies while drinking and smoking, which disgusts Amanda, causing her to throw his cigar in his drink. They talk about Trevor's reappearance, when Fabien LaRouche comes in and encourages Michael to join them in a yoga session.

main:25.text: Hood Safari is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given by Lamar Davis to protagonists Franklin Clinton and Trevor Philips at Franklin's House, in Strawberry, South Los Santos, San Andreas. As said above, the mission can be introduced in either Franklin's or Trevor's perspective. The mission begins at Franklin's house, where Lamar and Denise heckle the latter for his neglect of the CGF as of late.

main:26.text: Blitz Play is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V. It is either the second or the third heist mission in the game that protagonists Michael De Santa, Franklin Clinton and Trevor Philips execute. Michael, Franklin, and Trevor meet up with Steve Haines, Dave Norton, and Andreas Sanchez at the Murrieta Oil Fields to discuss business. Once there, Haines and Norton tell the protagonists that the FIB want to rob the IAA.

main:27.text: I Fought the Law... is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V given by Devin Weston to protagonists Franklin Clinton, Michael De Santa and Trevor Philips. Michael, Trevor, and Franklin meet Weston and Molly Schultz at a construction site in Alta. Weston wants the protagonists to steal an orange Entity XF MKB652 and a blue Cheetah SDTM1YP from two trust fund kids, Henry Smithe the 4th and Sebastian.

main:29.text: Mr. Richards is the first mission in Grand Theft Auto V to be given to protagonist Michael De Santa by Solomon Richards. Michael goes to the Backlot City movie studio to meet Solomon Richards. Solomon complains to Michael that Milton McIlroy, one of the stars of his upcoming film Meltdown has received a new agent, Rocco Pelosi, and is holding out for more money.

main:30.text: Caida Libre is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given by Martin Madrazo to protagonists Michael De Santa and Trevor Philips. Michael and Trevor are summoned to Madrazo's house in La Fuente Blanca, where Madrazo has a job for them. Madrazo's cousin Javier is going to testify against him; Madrazo wants Javier killed and sensitive documents retrieved. The player takes control of Michael.

main:31.text: Deep Inside is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Devin Weston. Franklin approaches the Backlot City movie studio in Downtown Los Santos. Once there, he calls Molly Schultz who directs him to his current target, the famous movie car JB 700.

main:32.text: Minor Turbulence is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V that protagonist Trevor Philips performs independently. Despite being one of Trevor's missions, the mission can only be triggered at the De Santa Residence by Franklin Clinton. Franklin arrives at Michael De Santa's house looking for him.

main:33.text: Paleto Score Setup is a heist setup mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given to protagonists Michael De Santa and Trevor Philips by FIB agent Steve Haines. Michael and Trevor meet at Trevor's meth lab in Sandy Shores. They are joined there by FIB agents Steve Haines and Dave Norton.

main:34.text: Military Hardware is a Heist Setup in Grand Theft Auto V. The player must complete it in preparation for The Paleto Score. Either Michael De Santa or Trevor Philips will be able to conduct this mission. The player must stop a military convoy which consists of a Barracks and two Crusaders. It is travelling through Grand Senora Desert, heading past Great Chaparral.

main:35.text: Predator is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V which Trevor Philips performs with the assistance of Michael De Santa and Franklin Clinton. The mission can be started by any of the three protagonists, though starting the mission with Franklin will skip the opening cutscene (usually happens if the player switches to Franklin after Paleto Score Setup).

main:36.text: The Paleto Score is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V. It is the fourth heist mission in the game that protagonists Michael De Santa, Trevor Philips, and Franklin Clinton undertake. In order to perform the heist, Michael or Trevor must perform a side-mission (Heist Setup) to get the necessary equipment.

main:37.text: Derailed is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V which protagonist Trevor Philips performs with the assistance of fellow protagonist Michael De Santa. Michael is in Trevor's trailer when Ron Jakowski arrives. The two exchange quips. Soon, Trevor also arrives. It is revealed that Merryweather Security is transporting precious cargo by train. Trevor wants Michael's help to steal the payload.

main:38.text: Monkey Business is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given by FIB agent Steve Haines to protagonists Michael De Santa, Franklin Clinton, and Trevor Philips. Michael, Franklin, and Trevor meet at Cape Catfish. Soon, Agents Haines and Dave Norton arrive. Haines wants the protagonists to steal a chemical weapon from the Humane Labs and Research, an IAA research facility.

main:39.text: Hang Ten is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V that protagonist Trevor Philips does independently. However, Michael De Santa makes an appearance at the end of the mission. Now free from the threat of the Madrazo Cartel after returning Patricia Madrazo to her husband, Trevor returns to Floyd's apartment, and runs into Floyd Hebert, who refuses to let him pass.

main:40.text: Surveying The Score is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V performed by protagonists Trevor Philips, Michael De Santa and Franklin Clinton. Trevor, Michael, and Franklin meet in Trevor's office in the Vanilla Unicorn. Soon, Lester arrives. They're gather together to plan the "Big One", the heist of the Union Depository.

main:41.text: Bury the Hatchet is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V that protagonists Michael De Santa and Trevor Philips both perform independently with each other. This mission can be performed from either Michael or Trevor's point of view, and is a major turning point in the storyline where Trevor finally sees through Michael's lies.

main:42.text: Pack Man is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given by business tycoon Devin Weston to protagonists Franklin Clinton and Trevor Philips. Franklin pulls up in front of Lamar's house around the corner from his old safehouse on Forum Drive in Strawberry. He receives a call from Lamar.

main:43.text: Fresh Meat is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V that protagonist Franklin Clinton does independently. Fellow protagonist Michael De Santa is also playable during a later part in the mission, and Trevor Philips can start this mission too, although he will only participate in the opening cutscene and then walk away.

main:44.text: Cleaning out the Bureau is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Michael De Santa by FIB agent Dave Norton, although it appears under Lester Crest's list of missions. It is the first part of the fifth heist mission. Michael arrives at Darnell Bros.

main:45.text: Architect's Plans is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V. It is the first of three heist setups for The Bureau Raid if the Fire Crew approach is chosen, or the only one if the Roof Entry approach is chosen. The mission can be started in one of two ways. First, if the player is in the role of Michael De Santa, Franklin will text Michael regarding Chip Peterson shortly after the completion of Cleaning out the Bureau.

main:46.text: Reuniting the Family is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V that protagonist Michael De Santa performs independently. Alone in his mansion, Michael falls asleep while watching a film. When he wakes up, Jimmy has returned home. Jimmy first apologizes for spiking Michael's drink, then proceeds to blame his father for his own shortcomings before ultimately admitting that he misses his dad.

main:47.text: The Bureau Raid is a heist in Grand Theft Auto V. It is the fifth heist mission in the game that protagonists Michael De Santa and Franklin Clinton execute. In order to perform the heist, a couple of side missions (Heist Setups) must be performed to get the necessary equipment. The preparation missions vary based on the approach chosen in Architect's Plans.

main:48.text: The Wrap Up is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given by FIB agent Dave Norton to protagonist Michael De Santa. Fellow protagonist Trevor Philips is also playable during a later part in the mission. Michael and Dave meet at one of the lookout points at the Kortz Center as Dave was none too impressed with how Michael and Trevor attacked Merryweather and they have discussed things.

main:49.text: Lamar Down is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V which protagonist Franklin Clinton performs with the assistance of Michael De Santa and Trevor Philips. Franklin is resting at his home, when he is visited by Tanisha. Tanisha tells him that Stretch has set Lamar up with the Ballas, who are holding Lamar hostage at the Paleto Forest Sawmill.

main:50.text: The Ballad of Rocco is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given to protagonist Michael De Santa by Solomon Richards. Michael arrives at Backlot City where he discovers Rocco Pelosi and his associate Gianni attacking Solomon. As Michael approaches, Pelosi yells at Solomon about honoring a contract, then he and his associate escape in Rocco's red Fugitive. Solomon asks Michael to track down and kill his two assailants.

main:51.text: Legal Trouble is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V given by Solomon Richards to Michael De Santa. After arriving at Solomon's office, Michael is surprised to find Devin Weston and his assistant Molly Schultz there. Molly tells Michael that his role as producer is over. Devin then thanks Michael for his help.

main:53.text: Planning the Score is the first part of the multi-mission final heist in Grand Theft Auto V, The Big Score. This mission is essentially an interactive cutscene in which the player chooses the approach to take and the team members to use. Michael, Trevor, Franklin and Lester reunite in the Vanilla Unicorn to discuss how they are going to proceed with the Union Depository heist.

main:54.text: The Big Score is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V. It is the sixth and final heist mission that protagonists Michael De Santa, Trevor Philips and Franklin Clinton undertake. It is also the penultimate mission in the storyline. The player steals a total of $201,600,000 for the obvious approach, or $201,300,000 for the subtle approach.

side:1.text: Pulling Favors is a Strangers and Freaks mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Tonya Wiggins. This is the only Strangers and Freaks mission that is mandatory in order to complete the storyline, as it unlocks Chop and Marriage Counseling. Completing this mission contributes toward 100% completion. Tonya and her boyfriend, JB Bradshaw, are old friends of Franklin's.

side:2.text: Pulling Another Favor is a Strangers and Freaks side mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Tonya Wiggins. Completing this side mission contributes toward 100% completion. Franklin meets with Tonya again in front of the liquor store. Franklin tells her she's looking terrible and she begins insulting him.

side:3.text: Pulling Favors Again is a Strangers and Freaks side mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Tonya Wiggins. Completing this side mission contributes toward 100% completion. After completing Pulling Another Favor, Tonya will send Franklin a text asking him to call her so she can elaborate on her situation.

side:4.text: Still Pulling Favors is a Strangers and Freaks side mission in Grand Theft Auto V. Completing this side-mission contributes toward 100% completion. Franklin receives a text from Tonya and calls her to hear her elaborate. She claims that she and JB have gone clean, but that JB is feeling sick because of it. Too sick to work, so she asks Franklin to help her tow another car.

side:5.text: Pulling One Last Favor is a Strangers and Freaks side mission in Grand Theft Auto V. Completing this side mission contributes toward 100% completion. Tonya is back in front of the liquor store in Strawberry when Franklin rolls up. Franklin is disappointed in her because she still looks and acts like a habitual crack user despite having told him that she and JB quit.

side:6.text: What Lies Beneath is a Strangers and Freaks side mission in Grand Theft Auto V. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion. After all 30 of the Submarine Pieces are collected, the player must return to the Sonar Collections Dock and talk to Abigail to complete the mission.

side:11.text: Grass Roots is a business in Grand Theft Auto IV, Episodes from Liberty City and Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars based in Liberty City, Liberty. The business has one branch on Cayuga Avenue in Schottler, Broker, and another on Saratoga Avenue in Willis, Dukes.

side:13.text: Paparazzo is a Strangers and Freaks mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given by Beverly Felton to protagonist Franklin Clinton. The player must complete the first towing mission for Tonya to unlock this mission. Franklin meets a paparazzo named Beverly hiding in the parking lot of the unnamed Chinese restaurant on Eclipse Boulevard in West Vinewood.

side:14.text: Paparazzo - The Sex Tape is a Strangers and Freaks side mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given to Franklin by Beverly Felton. Franklin approaches Beverly near West Vinewood. Beverly has heard that Poppy Mitchell is engaging in anal sex with Justin (one of her co-stars) in the Gentry Manor Hotel and wants to catch it on video. Beverly leads Franklin through a nearby hotel, then gives Franklin a camera.

side:15.text: Paparazzo - The Partnership is a Strangers and Freaks mission given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Beverly Felton. In West Vinewood, Franklin finds Beverly lurking in a dumpster near a steak house. Beverly emerges from the dumpster and tells Franklin that he has recently snagged a reality show. Beverly asks Franklin's help in getting yet more celebrity pictures, to which Franklin reluctantly agrees.

side:16.text: Paparazzo - The Meltdown is a Strangers and Freaks mission given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Beverly Felton. Franklin enters a marked area in Downtown Vinewood. Upon entering the area and a call from Beverly, Franklin sees a sports car rush past with police cars in hot pursuit. Beverly calls Franklin, who informs him that the police are chasing actress Poppy Mitchell, who is supposedly drunk.

side:17.text: Paparazzo - The Highness is a Strangers and Freaks mission given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Beverly Felton. The player as Franklin enters the marked area in Mirror Park, leading to a call from Beverly who informs him that English royal Princess Georgina is at the moment purchasing marijuana from a street dealer. Beverly tells Franklin to get a picture of the deal after meeting the contact.

side:18.text: Paparazzo - Reality Check is a Strangers and Freaks mission in Grand Theft Auto V given by Beverly Felton to protagonist Franklin Clinton. After taking pictures of Poppy Mitchell and Princess Georgina, Franklin confronts Beverly in front of The Generic Hotel in West Vinewood to collect his money after a few in-game hours.

side:19.text: An American Welcome is a Strangers and Freaks mission in the series Minute Men in Grand Theft Auto V. It is given to protagonist Trevor Philips by Joe and Josef. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion. Trevor meets Joe and Josef beside their Park Ranger, parked along a road north of the Alamo Sea.

side:20.text: Minute Man Blues is a Strangers and Freaks mission given to Trevor Philips by Manuel. It is the last of the missions concerning the Civil Border Patrol. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion.

side:21.text: Fair Game is a Strangers and Freaks mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given to protagonist Trevor Philips by Cletus Ewing. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion. Trevor receives a text from Cletus, asking Trevor to meet him down at the lodge in Paleto Forest. There, Cletus gives Trevor a deer call and states that the two are going to go hunting.

side:22.text: Risk Assessment is the first in a series of Strangers and Freaks missions in Grand Theft Auto V. It is given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Dom Beasley. While traveling through Vinewood Hills, Franklin comes across a barking dog.

side:23.text: Liquidity Risk is a Strangers and Freaks side mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Dom Beasley. Franklin meets Dom at the Los Santos International Airport. After a brief cutscene, the two mount Blazer quads and drive onto the airport's tarmac. Franklin follows Dom up the ramp of a rolling cargo plane. Once both are inside, the plane takes off.

side:24.text: Targeted Risk is a Strangers and Freaks mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Dom Beasley. Franklin meets Dom on the roof of the Maze Bank Tower in Downtown Los Santos. Dom convinces Franklin to take part in another stunt. After Franklin dons a jumpsuit, the two leap from the Tower.

side:25.text: Uncalculated Risk is a Strangers and Freaks mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Dom Beasley. Completing it contributes toward 100% completion. The mission only becomes available after completing all 13 Parachute Jumps unlocked after the mission Risk Assessment; although all three characters can do the jumps, only Franklin can trigger this mission.

side:26.text: A Starlet in Vinewood is a side mission in Grand Theft Auto V that becomes available after collecting all fifty Letter Scraps. Even though any character can collect the scraps, only Franklin can complete the mission. After collecting all fifty of the letter scraps and discovering the identity of the assassin of Leonora Johnson, Franklin goes to Peter Dreyfuss' house in Vinewood Hills to confront him.

side:27.text: Seeking the Truth is a Strangers and Freaks side mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Michael De Santa by the infamous Epsilon Program. The mission is the first time members of the Epsilon make an appearance in the game. It is the first mission in the Truth series of missions. It is located in Raton Canyon. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion.

side:28.text: Accepting the Truth is a Strangers and Freaks side mission in Grand Theft Auto V for protagonist Michael De Santa. It's the second mission in The Truth mission series. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion. The player is directed to go to Ice Planet Jewelry, located opposite Pitchers on Clinton Avenue in Downtown Vinewood.

side:29.text: Assuming the Truth is a Stranger mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Michael De Santa by the infamous Epsilon Program. It is the third mission in the Truth mission series. The location is Grapeseed. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion. When Michael arrives, he sees Marnie who tells him that his name is actually Zolag.

side:30.text: Chasing the Truth is a Strangers and Freaks mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Michael De Santa by the Epsilon Program. It is the fourth mission in the Truth mission series. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion. Michael meets Marnie Allen and the famous actor and Epsilon member Jimmy Boston at a farm in Grapeseed.

side:31.text: Bearing the Truth is a Strangers and Freaks mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Michael De Santa by the infamous Epsilon Program. It is the fifth mission in the truth mission series. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion. Michael goes to see Marnie Allen in an alleyway in Downtown Vinewood, Los Santos.

side:32.text: Delivering the Truth is a Strangers and Freaks mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Michael De Santa by the infamous Epsilon Program. It's the sixth mission in the truth mission series. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion. Michael meets a member of the Epsilon Program called Tom along an unnamed road off the Great Ocean Highway just a bit west of Fort Zancudo.

side:33.text: Exercising the Truth is a Strangers and Freaks mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given to protagonist Michael De Santa by the Epsilon Program. This mission is the penultimate mission in The Truth mission series. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion. The mission begins at an unnamed collection of mobile homes in the western half of the Grand Senora Desert, just north of Harmony.

side:34.text: Unknowing the Truth is a Strangers and Freaks mission in Grand Theft Auto V. This is the final mission from The Truth mission series given to protagonist Michael De Santa by the Epsilon Program.

side:35.text: Hao Street Races are a series of street races in Grand Theft Auto V for protagonist Franklin Clinton. The first race is presented to the player by Hao, during the Strangers and Freaks mission Shift Work. After completing the mission, a new race will be unlocked by a text message from Hao and Franklin must continue to win the races in order to proceed to the next one.

side:36.text: Closing the Deal is a Strangers and Freaks mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Trevor Philips by Josh Bernstein. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion. As a reward for Trevor's previous job for Josh, Josh gives Trevor a room in the Bilingsgate Motel where Trevor spends the night with Josh's wife.

side:38.text: Breach of Contract is the final Strangers and Freaks mission for protagonist Trevor Philips involving Josh Bernstein in Grand Theft Auto V. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion. Trevor arrives at Josh's house on West Eclipse Boulevard to find an Interceptor parked out front and Josh describing to two Los Santos Police officers the man who burned down his home.

side:39.text: Exercising Demons is a series of three Strangers and Freaks side-missions in Grand Theft Auto V. Michael, Franklin and Trevor each have a side-mission bearing this name. Completing Franklin's segment contributes toward 100% Completion. Mary-Ann is a high-stress exercise fanatic who is clearly hostile toward males in general.

side:40.text: Exercising Demons is a series of three Strangers and Freaks side-missions in Grand Theft Auto V. Michael, Franklin and Trevor each have a side-mission bearing this name. Completing Franklin's segment contributes toward 100% Completion. Mary-Ann is a high-stress exercise fanatic who is clearly hostile toward males in general.

side:41.text: Exercising Demons is a series of three Strangers and Freaks side-missions in Grand Theft Auto V. Michael, Franklin and Trevor each have a side-mission bearing this name. Completing Franklin's segment contributes toward 100% Completion. Mary-Ann is a high-stress exercise fanatic who is clearly hostile toward males in general.

side:46.text: Mrs. Philips and Damaged Goods are two Strangers and Freaks side missions in Grand Theft Auto V, given to protagonist Trevor Philips by his mother, Mrs. Philips, who makes her only appearance in the game. Completing these side missions do not contribute towards 100% completion.

side:47.text: Vinewood Souvenirs - WillieWillieWillie and Willy are used interchangeably throughout depending on game version. is a Strangers and Freaks mission in Grand Theft Auto V for protagonist Trevor Philips in the Vinewood Souvenirs series. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion. Trevor tracks Willie to a night club in Vinewood.

side:48.text: Vinewood Souvenirs - Tyler is a side mission in the series of the Vinewood Souvenirs missions. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion. The mission begins when Trevor approaches the home of Tyler Dixon. The home is surrounded by a wall which can be easily climbed. Inside the estate, there is a gardener working by a van who can be knocked out.

side:49.text: Vinewood Souvenirs are seven Strangers and Freaks missions. The missions are given to Trevor Philips by Nigel and Mrs. Thornhill in the Vinewood Hills after completing Friends Reunited.

side:50.text: Vinewood Souvenirs are seven Strangers and Freaks missions. The missions are given to Trevor Philips by Nigel and Mrs. Thornhill in the Vinewood Hills after completing Friends Reunited.

side:51.text: This is one of the Vinewood Souvenirs missions that Trevor receives from Nigel and Mrs. Thornhill. This mission becomes available once Trevor has retrieved "souvenirs" from the first four celebrities. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion. Trevor meets Nigel in Del Perro, where he hands Nigel the four items he has collected so far. While the two are talking, Mrs.

side:52.text: Vinewood Souvenirs - The Last Act is a Strangers and Freaks mission for Trevor Philips. It is the final mission involving Trevor, Nigel, and Mrs. Thornhill. Completing this side mission does not contribute towards 100% completion. Trevor meets Nigel behind a business in Strawberry. Nigel is standing near the car used in Vinewood Souvenirs - Al Di Napoli. Al Di Napoli can be heard yelling from the trunk.

side:53.text: Far Out is a Strangers and Freaks mission in Grand Theft Auto V given by Omega to protagonist Franklin Clinton after the mission Fame or Shame has been completed. Franklin will meet Omega outside his trailer in east Sandy Shores. He is searching his property for alien life forms. He scans Franklin and asks if he has seen any aliens and describes his own close encounter.

side:54.text: The Final Frontier is a Strangers and Freaks mission in Grand Theft Auto V given by Omega to protagonist Franklin Clinton after the 50 Spaceship Parts have been collected. Franklin will meet Omega inside his laboratory in a trailer park near the RON Alternates Wind Farm. He congratulates Franklin for collecting the spaceship parts and opens his garage to show Franklin his reconstructed invention with the last part.

side:55.text: The Last One is a Strangers and Freaks mission in Grand Theft Auto V. The mission, unlocked once the player attains 100% completion of the game, can only be performed by Franklin Clinton. Franklin encounters a hunter in the Raton Canyon trying to hunt a Sasquatch. After a conversation, he convinces Franklin to help him. After locating the beast, Franklin chases it down.

side:56.text: The Hotel Assassination is the first assassination mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Lester Crest. Franklin will get a text message from Lester, in which Lester informs Franklin to meet him at Del Perro Pier for an opportunity.

side:57.text: The Multi Target Assassination is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V, given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Lester Crest. Franklin arrives at a Limited Service gas station in Little Seoul to discover a nearby payphone ringing. He answers; Lester is on the line. Lester tells Franklin that Redwood Cigarettes has bribed four corrupt jurors to rig an emphysema-related class action lawsuit against the company.

side:58.text: The Vice Assassination is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Lester Crest. Franklin arrives at a payphone at Legion Square where he is contacted by Lester. This time, Lester wants Franklin to assassinate Jackson Skinner, the head of product development for the company Facade.

side:59.text: The Bus Assassination the fourth Assassination mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Lester Crest. Lester tells Franklin that his next target is Isaac Penny, a venture capitalist whom Lester has discovered has threatened to outsource thousands of jobs once he gains a controlling share of Vapid Motor Company; Lester informs Franklin that Penny is cheap, regularly relying on Los…

side:60.text: The Construction Assassination is a mission in Grand Theft Auto V given to protagonist Franklin Clinton by Lester Crest. It is also the final assassination mission in the game. The mission is received by telephone like the previous Lester missions. The target now is a corrupt businessman called Enzo Bonelli; he is running a construction site in Downtown Los Santos.
